Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic for growth stocks as Treasury yields ease, which is a tailwind for your tech and chip-heavy portfolio. This could provide some breathing room.

Your holdings: SOXL (-51.41%) and SPAL (-30.02%) are your biggest concerns; both are leveraged ETFs in SELL status, and margin amplifies these deep drawdowns. QQQI (-3.58%) is also on TRIM.

Watch: Keep a close eye on SOXL and SPAL's stops. Also, monitor SMH (-9.96%) for any further weakness, given your concentration in chips.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions, as market tailwinds don't erase existing deep losses.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL given its -51.41% loss and SELL status; respect its stop at 200.00.
Review SPAL, down -30.02% and on SELL status; consider tightening its stop from 21.38.
QQQI is on TRIM at -3.58%; consider reducing exposure, especially with its stop at 52.00.
